name: Shinafuji Satomi
source: Head of the Intelligence Department of KOKON. She is an intelligent and motherly woman who has risen to the position of Graham's right-hand at a young age. She was once in a relationship with Tsunakawa, but they are now friends, perhaps because she hates to be restrained by others.
